description: This file contains implementation of tensor comparison operations optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including functions for 'isin', 'where', 'nan_to_num', and related kernel dispatchers.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A wrapper around MPSGraph for caching the graph and associated tensors for a specific operation to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: isin_Tensor_Tensor_out_mps
methods.description: Performs 'isin' operation between two tensors on MPS, storing the result in 'out'.

methods.name: isin_Scalar_Tensor_out_mps
methods.description: Performs 'isin' operation between a scalar and a tensor on MPS, storing the result in 'out'.

methods.name: nan_to_num_out_mps
methods.description: Replaces NaN and infinity values in tensor 'self' with specified numbers, optimized for MPS backend.

methods.name: isneginf_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel to detect negative infinity in tensor elements on MPS.

methods.name: isposinf_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel to detect positive infinity in tensor elements on MPS.

methods.name: clamp_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel to clamp tensor values within a specified range on MPS.

methods.name: clamp_scalar_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel to clamp tensor values to scalar min and max values on MPS.

methods.name: clamp_min_scalar_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel to clamp tensor values from below with a scalar minimum on MPS.

methods.name: clamp_max_scalar_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel to clamp tensor values from above with a scalar maximum on MPS.
